apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Unified Consent API, including any path prefix (default https://uc.api.osano.com). The OSANO_API_BASE_URL environment variable is used when it is unset. Must use https, except for loopback hosts.

osanoApiKey.description: Osano Customer REST API key, sent as x-osano-api-key by the Cookie Consent resources and functions and by sendSubjectCode and verifySubjectCode. Set it with `pulumi config set osano:osanoApiKey --secret`; the OSANO_API_KEY environment variable is used when it is unset.

osano:index:Consent.description: Submits a Unified Consent decision for a subject. Consents are immutable in Osano: changing any input submits a new consent (replacement), and destroying the resource only removes it from Pulumi state. Refresh confirms that Osano still reports consent for the subject and never removes the resource, so a refresh cannot cause a consent to be submitted again. The resource cannot be imported, because Osano exposes only the merged consent of a subject. Set origin to gpc and omit actions to submit a Global Privacy Control consent, whose actions Osano derives and returns in gpcActions.

actions.description: Consent actions referencing privacy protocols (target) within a configuration (vendor). Required unless origin is gpc.

attributes.description: Optional key/value attributes stored with the consent record. Osano fills ipAddress and userAgent itself and overwrites values sent for those keys.

compliance.description: Optional compliance metadata such as the privacy policy version and GPC signal.

consentId.description: Synthetic identifier used by Pulumi to track consent submissions.

countryCodeOverride.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 country code Osano uses instead of resolving the caller's IP address. Set it when submitting from a pipeline, whose IP address says nothing about the subject.

gpcActions.description: The actions Osano derived for a GPC consent submitted without actions.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction, which must be one of the configuration's jurisdictions (see getCollections).

lastSynced.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the submission that created this resource.

origin.description: Origin of the consent: api (default) or gpc. With gpc and no actions, the consent is submitted to Osano's GPC endpoint, which derives the actions.

regionCodeOverride.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 region code Osano uses instead of resolving the caller's IP address.

sessionToken.description: Optional session token returned when the subject's profile was created.

subject.description: Subject identifiers used for the consent (verifiedId or anonymousId).

tags.description: Custom tags that Osano associates with the consent record.

customerId.description: The Osano customer ID that owns the configuration.

domains.description: Domains permitted to host the configuration.

lastPublished.description: Unix timestamp when Osano last published the configuration.

mode.description: Compliance mode: debug, permissive, or production.

orgIds.description: Optional organization IDs associated with the config.

publishStatus.description: Current Osano publication status for the configuration.

publishedRevision.description: Revision number most recently published by Osano.

updated.description: Unix timestamp when Osano last updated the configuration.

osano:index:CookieConsentPublication.description: Publishes an Osano Cookie Consent configuration, waits for completion, and returns its hosted CMP script. Import with the Osano config ID; deleting this resource only removes Pulumi state and does not unpublish the config.

changeToken.description: A caller-managed desired-state token. Changing it queues a new publication. Changing keepUnclassifiedTattles, description, or webhookUrl also republishes; when no input changes, nothing is published.

configId.description: The Osano Cookie Consent config ID to publish. This is also the import ID.

customerId.description: The Osano customer ID that owns the published configuration.

description.description: Optional description sent with the publication request.

keepUnclassifiedTattles.description: Whether publication preserves unclassified discoveries. Defaults to true to avoid unexpected deletion.

lastPublished.description: Unix timestamp of the completed Osano publication.

publishStatus.description: The Osano publication status: published after a completed publish, and possibly outdated after a refresh when the config changed outside a publish.

publishedRevision.description: The configuration revision most recently published by Osano.

scriptSrc.description: The public hosted Osano CMP JavaScript URL for this customer and config.

scriptTag.description: The complete public CMP script tag to place first in the site head, without async or defer attributes.

webhookUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL Osano calls when the publication completes. Osano does not document the call's payload or sign it, so use an unguessable URL; the value is stored as a secret.

osano:index:CookieConsentRule.description: Manages an Osano Cookie Consent (CMP) rule within a configuration. Import with `<configId>/<ruleId>`. Changing configId or storeType replaces the rule, and deleting this resource deletes the rule in Osano. An optional field the program never sets stays unmanaged: Osano's value is neither read into state nor cleared by an update; removing a field the program did set clears it in Osano.

description.description: Optional cookie description. Only supported for cookies; max 1000 characters.

expiry.description: Optional cookie expiry description. Only supported for cookies; max 50 characters.

storeType.description: The storage type category: cookies, scripts, iframes, localStorage.

title.description: Optional title for the rule, used in consent disclosure. Max 64 characters.

updated.description: Timestamp when the rule was last updated.

vendorName.description: Optional vendor name for the rule. Max 100 characters.

osano:index:getCookieConsentConfigs.description: Lists Cookie Consent configurations, optionally filtered by name, domains, organization, mode, or publish status, and returns each one's install script. Follows pagination until maxResults or the last page.

maxResults.description: Stop after this many configurations. Unset or 0 returns every matching configuration.

mode.description: Filter by compliance mode: debug, permissive, or production.

configs.description: The matching configurations, each with its install script.

configId.description: The config ID that was queried.

osano:index:getSession.description: Resolves a Unified Consent session ID to its subject's verified ID and profile, using the Unified Consent API key.

profile.description: The session's profile (email, firstName, lastName). Secret, because it is personal data.

verifiedId.description: The verified ID of the session's subject. Secret, because it identifies a person.

osano:index:getSubject.description: Fetches subject identifiers (subject, verified, anonymous IDs) for a reference or session ID.

referenceType.description: Reference type: subject (default) for a subject's verified or anonymous ID, or session for a session ID. anonymous is accepted as a deprecated alias of subject.

subjectRef.description: The subject reference to resolve: an anonymous ID, verified ID, or session ID.

anonymousId.description: The subject's anonymous ID, if any. Secret, because it identifies a person.

exists.description: Whether Osano knows the subject. The ID outputs are empty when false.

subjectId.description: The subject's Osano ID. Secret, because it identifies a person.

subjectRef.description: The subject reference that was resolved. Secret, because it identifies a person.

verifiedId.description: The subject's verified ID, if the subject is verified. Secret, because it identifies a person.

osano:index:getSubjectProfile.description: Reads a subject's profile (email and subject ID) using the Unified Consent API key. The outputs are secrets because they hold personal data.

subjectId.description: The subject ID whose profile is returned. Secret, because it identifies a person.

email.description: The subject's email address. Secret, because it is personal data.

exists.description: Whether Osano returned a profile for the subject.

profile.description: The complete profile Osano returned. Secret, because it is personal data.

subjectId.description: The subject ID that was looked up. Secret, because it identifies a person.

osano:index:getUnifiedConsent.description: Fetches the unified consent state for a subject reference using the Unified Consent API key.

countryCodeOverride.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 country code Osano uses instead of resolving the caller's IP address, which in a pipeline is the CI runner's.

referenceType.description: Reference type: subject (default) for a subject's verified or anonymous ID, or session for a session ID. anonymous is accepted as a deprecated alias of subject.

regionCodeOverride.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 region code Osano uses instead of resolving the caller's IP address.

subjectRef.description: The subject reference to look up: an anonymous ID, verified ID, or session ID.

conflicts.description: Conflicting consents Osano resolved, with the resolution and the actions in conflict. Secret, because it is the consent history of a person.

exists.description: Whether Osano has any consent for the subject.

subjectRef.description: The subject reference that was looked up. Secret, because it identifies a person.

unifiedConsent.description: The merged consent: subjectId, brandId, channelIds, jurisdiction, lastUpdateDate, lastConflictDate, actions, attributes, compliance, and tags. Secret, because the attributes hold the subject's IP address and user agent.

osano:index:sendSubjectCode.description: Sends a verification code to a subject's email or phone, authenticating with every configured key (the Osano API key, the Unified Consent API key, or both). Pulumi runs invokes on every preview, update, and refresh, so declaring this in a stack sends a new code each time; call it from automation rather than from long-lived stack code.

email.description: Email address to send the code to. Set exactly one of email or phone. Secret, because it is personal data.

hashedSubjectId.description: Optional hashed subject identifier, sent only when set. Osano's current API identifies the subject by email or phone.

phone.description: Phone number to send the code to by SMS. Set exactly one of email or phone. Secret, because it is personal data.

channel.description: The delivery channel: email or sms.

destination.description: The email address or phone number the code was sent to. Secret, because it is personal data.

hashedSubjectId.description: The hashed subject identifier sent with the request, if any.

session.description: The SMS challenge session, when Osano returns one; pass it to verifySubjectCode. Empty for email.

osano:index:verifySubjectCode.description: Verifies a subject profile using the code sent via email or SMS. Pulumi runs invokes on every preview, update, and refresh, and one-time codes cannot be reused, so call this from automation rather than from long-lived stack code.

code.description: The one-time verification code the subject received (6 characters by email, 8 by SMS).

email.description: Email address the code was sent to. Set exactly one of email or phone. Secret, because it is personal data.

hashedSubjectId.description: Optional hashed subject identifier, sent only when set.

phone.description: Phone number the code was sent to. Set exactly one of email or phone. Secret, because it is personal data.

session.description: The SMS challenge session. Required with phone; not used with email.

channel.description: The verification channel: email or sms.

destination.description: The email address or phone number that was verified. Secret, because it is personal data.

hashedSubjectId.description: The hashed subject identifier sent with the request, if any.

profile.description: The complete response Osano returned. Secret, because it can hold personal data.

verified.description: True when Osano accepted the code. A rejected code fails the invoke, as does a response that reports verified: false.

verifiedId.description: The subject's verified ID returned by Osano. Secret, because it identifies a person.
